name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited
summary: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited develops, owns, operates, and manages hotels and resorts under The Leela brand name in India. The company was formerly known as Schloss Bangalore Limited and changed its name to Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited in September 2025. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
